svg.title: Maknae action vocabulary: the complete 59-term map and the dependencies between them
svg.desc: Left-to-right dependency map of the complete action vocabulary, all fifty-nine terms. Three built terms appear at the top as their own boxes: liveness.ping, admin.whoami and fs.read. Below, twenty-four issues are arranged in five columns by dependency depth: column one is startable now, each later column is blocked by work to its left. Each box names its issue number, the capability it delivers, the vocabulary terms it implements, and the issues that block it. Issue 162, action-scoped grants, blocks eighteen of the twenty-three capability slices and is marked as the critical path. Two terms marked K, kernel.contain and kernel.session.terminate, are kernel action strings with no wire verb and are not reachable by any client.
svg.text: The action vocabulary — 59 terms and what blocks what
3 built, 56 enumerated-but-unbuilt across 24 issues. Tracked in epic #182; enumerated by #67. Columns run left to right by dependency depth.
kernel action string — no Verb variant, not client-reachable
BUILT — decided, dispatched and serving today
3 terms. Every other term in the vocabulary is enumerated and decided, and denies.
